messages:
Clara (Design): Quick notes from today's catalog review: presets are hard to find in the drawer, performance badges steal focus from model names in compare rows, and pinning clears between sessions. Proposing small, low-risk fixes below.

Vik (PM): Agree. Saved views drop-off in analytics. Suggest a compact presets row above filters (desktop) with a chevron to open manager. Add a tiny 'Apply to compare' checkbox.

Jon (Frontend): Badge issue is mostly styling. Current pills have full-bg + shadow. Suggest ghost chips (no shadow), smaller text 11px, subtle border, and right-align them so names don't wrap. CSS idea: `.perf-chip{ background:transparent; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-size:11px; padding:3px 6px; border-radius:6px; }`

Pri (Eng): For pin persistence we'll store per-user pins in a small table and return them on login. Fallback to localStorage for guests. API: GET/PUT /v1/me/pins. Also handle retired versions by soft-deleting pins.

Rae (A11y): A11y notes: badges need aria labels (e.g., `aria-label="98th percentile latency: 220ms"`). Presets row should be a toolbar (role="toolbar") with arrow-key nav and visible focus. Ensure contrast >=4.5:1 or bump size.

staging-bot: staging-bot: feature `ux/catalog-presets-ghost-badges` pushed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/catalog/compare

Clara (Design): Proposal (quick vote): 1) Move presets to top of filter rail as compact row + 'Apply to compare' checkbox; 2) Use ghost-style perf chips, smaller font, right-align; 3) Persist pins per-user with backend sync; 4) Add aria-labels & focus styles. React +1 to agree.

Jon (Frontend): :+1: I'll open a small PR with styles and keyboard tests.

Pri (Eng): :+1: I'll add the pins endpoint and migration plan.

Rae (A11y): :+1: I'll run NVDA/VoiceOver checks on staging and report issues.

Vik (PM): I'll make the Jira with acceptance criteria and analytics events (pin.create/pin.delete). Target: staging next week.

Clara (Design): Thanks all. I'll update the figma and paste links in the ticket. :sparkles:
